# Webstrail

> Webstrail is the product and engineering partner for dental companies across North America. We design, build, and run custom software for dentistry and nothing else — for DSOs, dental software providers, dental-tech founders, coaching firms, GPOs, and dental labs. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA. Tagline: Here for the build, and everything after.

Last updated: 2026-07-16

Webstrail builds custom dental software: revenue cycle management (RCM), practice growth, patient experience, platform and PMS integrations, and specialized builds (membership platforms, dental AI, MVPs, GPO/lab portals, consulting). We integrate with Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Denticon, CareStack, Curve Dental, tab32, and clearinghouses (DentalXChange, Vyne, Change Healthcare, Availity). Each service also has detailed solution pages (30+), one per capability — e.g. insurance eligibility verification, claims processing, A/R automation, dental CRM, multi-location analytics, online scheduling, AI treatment plans, PMS data migration, data warehouse, teledentistry, and more — under /services/<service>/<solution>/. We build and run what we ship. Contact: sales@webstrail.com · +1-630-931-8560.

## Services
- [Revenue Cycle Management](https://webstrail.com/services/revenue-cycle-management/): Custom dental RCM — eligibility, claims, ERA/EOB reconciliation, A/R automation, patient payments.
- [Practice Growth](https://webstrail.com/services/practice-growth/): Custom dental CRM, multi-location KPI analytics, patient reactivation, reputation automation.
- [Patient Experience](https://webstrail.com/services/patient-experience/): Patient portals, online scheduling, two-way communication, online payments.
- [Platform & Integrations](https://webstrail.com/services/platform-integrations/): PMS integration, unified data layer, two-way sync, data migration.
- [Specialized Builds](https://webstrail.com/services/specialized-builds/): Membership platforms, production AI, teledentistry, founder MVPs, GPO/lab portals, consulting.

## Who we build for
- [DSOs & Multi-Location Groups](https://webstrail.com/who-we-work-with/dsos-multi-location-groups/): Custom software for Dental Support Organizations — one revenue view and unified analytics across every PMS.
- [Dental Software Providers](https://webstrail.com/who-we-work-with/dental-software-providers/): Dedicated engineering, staff augmentation, and white-label builds.
- [Dental-Tech Founders](https://webstrail.com/who-we-work-with/dental-tech-founders/): MVP development and a technical product partner.
- [Practice & Coaching Firms](https://webstrail.com/who-we-work-with/practice-coaching-firms/): Assessment, coaching, and CRM platforms that scale a methodology.
- [GPOs](https://webstrail.com/who-we-work-with/gpos/): Member portals and vendor catalogs for group purchasing organizations.
- [Dental Labs & Adjacent](https://webstrail.com/who-we-work-with/dental-labs/): Lab, teledentistry, and insurance software.
